title: (Not oxford) MGD: Unmasking Meibomian Gland Dysfunction
summary: Meibomian Gland Dysfunction (MGD) is a chronic, diffuse abnormality of the meibomian glands, typically characterized by terminal duct obstruction and qualitative or quantitative changes in glandular secretion. It is the leading cause of evaporative dry eye disease worldwide.

sections.title: What is MGD?
sections.content: MGD stands for Meibomian Gland Dysfunction. It occurs when the tiny oil glands in your eyelids (meibomian glands) are blocked or produce poor-quality oil (meibum). This oil is crucial because it forms the outer layer of your tear film, preventing your tears from evaporating too quickly. Without enough high-quality oil, your eyes become dry, irritated, and inflamed.

sections.title: The Vicious Cycle of MGD
content: Step 1: Hyperkeratinization of the gland duct leads to obstruction.
Step 2: Meibum (oil) becomes stagnant within the gland.
Step 3: Bacteria proliferate and release enzymes (lipases).
Step 4: Enzymes break down healthy oils into irritating free fatty acids.
Step 5: Tear film instability leads to rapid evaporation and surface inflammation.

sections.title: CRITICAL WARNING SIGNS
content: Burning or stinging sensations
Persistent redness of the lid margins
Blurred vision that improves with blinking
Feeling of 'sand' or 'grit' in the eyes
Excessive watering (Reflex Tearing)

content.explanation: L for Lid hygiene (cleaning margins), I for Inflammation control, D for Daily warm compresses, S for Secretion improvement (Omega-3s).

sections.title: Key Risk Factors
content: Aging: Increased risk as we get older.
Digital Use: Reduced blink rate while staring at screens.
Hormones: Especially estrogen/androgen imbalances.
Medications: Retinoids (Acne meds) and Antihistamines.
Environment: Low humidity or high wind exposure.

sections.title: Management & Treatment
content: Warm Compresses: Melts hardened oils (at least 104°F).
Lid Debridement: Clearing debris from gland openings.
Thermal Pulsation: In-office automated heat/massage.
Omega-3 Supplements: Improves meibum consistency.
Topical Azithromycin: Targets both bacteria and inflammation.
